notes.title: TFN: Conversations with AI and Modifiers
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!
I would like to show you the new starting configuration, now more personalized than ever. One of the advantages of ATEG games is their strong customization of video games. In other games, you might be used to customizing graphics, the interface, audio, and controls, but in ATEG games, you customize the game itself, and we call this 'Options' for game options or 'Modifiers' and even 'GameLab'.

Third-party artificial intelligence systems are very robotic, which is why ATEG's conversation systems are used. They are completely natural and also allow for the coordination of actions through conversations. The ATEG conversation system is in constant evolution, and The Fallen Night represents the cornerstone of the evolution of chat with artificial intelligence for video games. I hope you enjoy a good chat with the AI, because in The Fallen Night, that's how you get to know the characters, forge alliances, relationships, and have a good time before a good fight in the bar.

notes.title: ATEG: New Improvements, Discoveries, and Development
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!-Cromos
Today the production of the video game Cromos resumes, and there are also great improvements added to the game, new vehicles, new jobs, new modifications, new artificial intelligence, and more. One of the things I look forward to finishing the most is the detective work, special forces (S.W.A.T), and military, which receives new upgrades from new discoveries and now has a random pattern allowing the game to create new scenarios for combat.
-General
Congratulations, we have new discoveries for Artificial Intelligence, allowing an NPC to behave more like a human and it is a general improvement that is being incorporated into all video games.
-The Fallen Night
The Fallen Night will receive new improvements, including more precise blockades, an improved civilian behavior system, and a new job, the detective job. Many more jobs will also be added as animations are created, although we cannot confirm it, it is possible that a cook job, tailor (but it will not allow you to create your own clothes due to complications), hunter, and fisherman will be added, all depending on how new animations are added. Soon you will be able to buy or build your house, have a job as a guard in an establishment or a fortress, street patrol (police), or field soldier, you will also be able to work as a spy. Don't forget that NPCs will have an advanced interaction and relationship system; you don't need to fight or shoot to have fun in a video game by ATEG.



The update will be received very soon, but due to a lot of work it may take some time and the improvements may come in several updates.

notes.title: ATEG: Advances (Dev)
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

I appreciate your patience..
I inform you that for the moment we are exclusively working on the video game Bulletproof to achieve a quick release in 2025. It is a very large game that requires a lot of work time, but it is truly fascinating. In the Gym World, you can go to the store to buy products to maintain a proper diet and go to the gym to sculpt your body and win the bodybuilding competition. In the Boxing Tournament, you must train to become the current boxing champion. Your actions will determine your success and how to defeat other players, but it is nothing compared to everything that the game includes. If you go to the Horror Fair (another world), you must be careful of the clown, as he is not friendly. There are also plans to incorporate the most important sports in the world along with the Video Game World, where you can recreate the old times and, like everything, compete against other players or join them in the show. However, the good news is that now ATEG Studios is stronger in developing more stunning video games and The Fallen Night will feature this by incorporating precise animations of various player actions including greater interaction with the environment.

notes.title: TFN: Important Announcement and Blocking System
notes.content:
Important announcement!

Over time ATEG Studios has focused on functionality before detail, since it meets many expectations desired by players to offer the best entertainment in the industry, however today it was possible to notice the lack of detail in the field of animation, so there will be a massive replacement of animations over time,  to offer the most realistic detail you can see in a video game, this improvement will apply to all ATEG Studios video games, although it will be more focused on the 5 Best Games of ATEG Studios (Eighteen, Seventeen, Cromos, Daddy Bear and Bulletproof), however The Fallen Night has great potential as a medieval game and will not be left lightly but its attack animations are perfect so they are not going to be replaced, only more attacks will be added for the Story mode and MMORPG, each mode has been thought to offer a unique experience, in the case of the Story mode it is mainly based on a real soldier from medieval times while the mode Skirmish is based on the role of each soldier from medieval times and in the MMORPG mode it is based more on realism/fantasy classes, on the other hand you can feel happy that it has been decided to scale realism in The Fallen Night with the most advanced locking system in history after AC3 and AC4, the blocking system connects to a base and starts to use animations of the 15 directions where they can attack it being very similar to the experience of AC3 and AC4, although it is a great improvement it is not the only one planned, among them are the pushes, distractions such as throwing dirt, progressive learning in Story mode,  combat on horseback, the creation of a kingdom and an army and much more, everything that makes TFN more immersive will be welcome and don't worry about the budget, our interest is more passion than monetary.

notes.title: ATEG: New Systems (+Realism)
notes.content:
Hello gamers! How are you?

Today I come to announce the progress that has been made in ATEG Studios, the reason why ATEG games last a long time for their release or in their update is because research is carried out to optimize and improve the game as well as the creation of very sophisticated systems, in ATEG Studios our specialty is to offer infinite entertainment and we have many ways to do it,  this entertainment technique consists of replacing the story with infinite missions and activities, but that does not mean that it cannot have a linear story and you should know that various techniques have recently been carried out to turn a Bot or NPC into a competent player controlled by the AI.

I am proud to announce that the following systems are in operation or about to be developed out:

-911 Operator for Project Bulletproof, Cromos and Eighteen. (Ultra-advanced search system)
-Standalone Story for The Fallen Night Project, Cromos and Eighteen. (Quest system created by the player during gameplay)
-Infinite Entertainment for The Fallen Night Project, Cromos and Eighteen. (Infinite Quest System)
-Operations System (Operational) for Project Bulletproof, Eighteen Gold, Cromos and Eighteen. (Tactical operations system, replacing CSGO-style rotary modes)
-GTA system (CSGO + GTA style) for Project Bulletproof and Eighteen Gold. (Set of systems that make a world more alive)
-Intelligent Optimization System (still under research) for Project Bulletproof, The Fallen Night, Eighteen Gold, Cromos and Eighteen. (Technique set system to optimize the game to its maximum capacity)
-Law System for Project Bulletproof, The Fallen Night, Cromos and Eighteen. (System that controls what is not allowed by law within the world or the city)
-Smart Missions for Project Bulletproof, The Fallen Night and Eighteen Gold and Smart Missions 2 for Project Cromos and Eighteen.

-Solutions Applied to the Bulletproof Project (Smoothing of animation and correction of the shooting system)
-Future Solutions to Project Bulletproof (Correction of the medieval combat system and the martial arts combat system)
-Future Solutions to The Fallen Night Project and Eighteen Gold (Reload Fix, IronSight System Fix, Bot Behavior Fix, and Death System Fix)

/-The Fallen Night
